summary: Full backend + frontend end-to-end testing for EDND Services. Backend pytest suite (7 tests) all pass. Frontend homepage loads, service-row deep-link pre-selects service in wizard, full 5-step wizard flow submits successfully, admin page shows submitted request, and contact form clears after successful submission with sonner toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') - consider lifespan handler (non-blocking).
Date field on StaffRequest is a string (not validated as date); acceptable for MVP but consider using date type and min validation server-side to match frontend.
CORS allow_origins default '*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; harmless here since no auth cookies, but should be tightened if auth added.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed staff request and contact enquiries during API and UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints (/api/staff-requests GET/POST, /api/contact GET/POST) working with proper 422 validation. Wizard deep-link (?service=) correctly pre-selects. Admin page fetches both lists on mount, sorted newest first, no MongoDB _id leakage.
